ic_name: TIA/EIA-485 (RS-485 via TI SLLA272C Design Guide)
signaling_summary: RS-485 IS a mixed-signal analog-digital interface: differential analog bus driven by digital TTL/CMOS-level driver-input D and producing a digital TTL/CMOS-level receiver-output R. The bus side carries analog voltages; the host side carries logic levels.

driver_specifications.min_differential_output_loaded: 1.5 V across a 54-ohm test load (two 120-ohm terminations in parallel + 32 unit loads).
driver_specifications.supply: Single +5 V (most common); 3.3 V variants also widely available.
driver_specifications.test_load: 54 ohm differential (matches worst-case bus loading per spec).
driver_specifications.short_circuit_protection: Required by all compliant drivers; current-limited to prevent damage on bus contention.

receiver_specifications.min_differential_input_sensitivity: ±200 mV across the entire common-mode range.
receiver_specifications.common_mode_range: -7 V to +12 V referenced to receiver ground.
receiver_specifications.fractional_unit_loads: 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 UL devices commonly available — 1/8 UL allows 256 transceivers per bus.
receiver_specifications.input_hysteresis: Manufacturer-defined; small hysteresis prevents noise-induced output chatter near the ±200 mV threshold.
receiver_specifications.failsafe: Modern transceivers integrate open-circuit, short-circuit, and idle-bus failsafe biasing that drives R to a determined HIGH state when V_AB is near zero or the bus is undriven.

noise_margins.transmitter_margin_per_spec: 1.5 V driver minus 200 mV receiver threshold = 1.3 V differential noise margin in normal operation.
noise_margins.internal_failsafe_worst_case_margin: approximately 10 mV (drawback of integrated failsafe alone in noisy environments).
noise_margins.external_failsafe_target_VAB: 200 mV + V_noise to restore robust margin in noisy environments.

common_mode_range_engineering.ground_potential_difference_mitigation: Use digital isolators + isolated DC/DC across the transceiver supply and signal lines when GPD may approach or exceed ±7 V.

failsafe_external_biasing.purpose: Generate sufficient differential bus voltage V_AB so that V_AB ≥ 200 mV + V_noise on an idle bus.
failsafe_external_biasing.worked_example_5V_supply: V_BUS_min = 4.75 V (5 V - 5 %); V_AB target = 0.25 V; Z0 = 120 ohm → R_B ≈ 528 ohm. Insert two ~523 ohm resistors in series with the termination R_T to form the divider.
failsafe_external_biasing.topology: Two pull resistors RB at each end of the bus: one from line A to +V_BUS (pull-up), one from line B to GND (pull-down).

esd_protection_examples: Modern TI RS-485 transceivers integrate ESD protection from 16 kV to 30 kV (IEC 61000-4-2 / HBM).
